BuildFlow Terms of Service

Last Updated: September 2026

1. Overview

BuildFlow (“we,” “us,” “our,” or “Company”) provides automated website design, hosting, and maintenance services to service-based businesses (“you,” “your,” or “Customer”). By purchasing a BuildFlow plan, you agree to these Terms of Service.

Service: BuildFlow builds a website for your business based on information you provide, then hosts and maintains it on our infrastructure. Under our default plan (Managed Growth), BuildFlow operates the site as an ongoing service — no code, hosting, or DNS control is handed to you. Under the Ownership plan, we export a static version of the site to your own host and end the ongoing relationship.

Plans & Pricing:

  • Managed Growth — $99/mo (default): Hosting, SSL, CDN, custom domain, local + AI SEO, unlimited small content edits, monthly check-in, and lead-capture machinery (fast site, click-to-call, quote/contact forms routed to you). Annual option: $990/yr. An optional $199 setup fee applies and is waived for launch / early customers.
  • Ownership — $497 one-time (downsell): A static starter site exported and deployed to your own host/account, plus one month of transition support. After that, there is no ongoing BuildFlow service. You own the exported files. Hosting, domain, and email costs become your responsibility at handoff.

Cold outreach is quoted at Managed Growth. Ownership is offered only if you decline a monthly plan.

2. Managed Growth — What You Get and What We Retain

Included in your $99/mo:

  • Hosting on our infrastructure (Railway + Cloudflare), SSL, CDN
  • Custom domain routing
  • Local SEO and AI-search optimization
  • Unlimited small content edits (email them in; typical turnaround 2 business days)
  • Monthly check-in
  • Lead-capture machinery: performance-optimized site, click-to-call, quote/contact forms delivered to you by email and SMS

What BuildFlow retains under Managed Growth:

  • The site runs on our multi-tenant platform. We do not hand over source code, server access, or DNS control.
  • We maintain SSL renewal, backups, security patches, and framework updates.
  • We target 99.5% uptime, measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.

Scope of “small content edits”:

  • Text changes, swapping photos, updating hours/services/service areas, contact details, testimonials, minor color or typography tweaks.
  • New page types, new functionality, integrations, or structural redesigns are not “small edits.” Where feasible we add them as configuration-flagged features available to all customers; otherwise they are declined. We do not write per-customer custom code.

3. Domain Names

If you provide a domain you already own:

  • You remain the registrar account owner.
  • We add DNS records pointing your domain to our servers.
  • You may remove those records and move your domain at any time (doing so takes your Managed Growth site offline).
  • You pay your registrar’s annual renewal fee (~$12–15/year).

If we register a domain for you:

  • We register it with you as the registrant.
  • The registration/renewal fee (~$12/year) is billed to you or added to your invoice.
  • You receive registrar login access and may transfer the domain at any time.
  • We do not auto-renew on your behalf; renewal notices go to your email.

4. Billing, Cancellation & Site Takedown

Billing (Managed Growth):

  • The $99/mo fee (or $990/yr if you choose annual) is billed in advance via Stripe.
  • The first payment (and setup fee, if not waived) must clear before we begin work.
  • Monthly plans renew automatically each month until cancelled. Annual plans renew each year unless cancelled before the renewal date.
  • Failed payment: we email you and retry. If payment is not resolved within 10 days, the site may be suspended.

Cancellation (Managed Growth):

  • You may cancel at any time by email. Cancellation stops future billing.
  • We do not prorate or refund the current billing period.
  • On cancellation, your site goes offline at the end of the paid period.
  • Your domain remains yours. A one-time static export of your site to your own host is available as a paid service at Ownership pricing ($497).

Ownership plan:

  • The $497 fee is one-time and non-refundable once the export and handoff are delivered.
  • Includes one month of transition support from handoff. After that, no ongoing service.

We may suspend or terminate either plan if:

  • You materially breach these Terms (illegal content, harassment, spam, IP infringement).
  • Payment is declined, invalid, or unresolved past the grace period.
  • The site is used for phishing, malware, fraud, or illegal activity.

5. Service Level & Maintenance

What we maintain (Managed Growth):

  • Server uptime, targeting 99.5% monthly availability (excluding scheduled maintenance)
  • Automatic backups (daily, retained 30 days)
  • Automatic SSL renewal
  • Security patches and framework updates
  • DNS routing and domain pointing

Scheduled maintenance:

  • Performed 1–4 times per year, typically 2–4 hours.
  • Windows: Sunday 2 AM – 6 AM PT, with advance notice where possible.
  • Your site may be briefly offline during maintenance.

Your responsibility:

  • Accuracy and legality of all content you provide.
  • Managing your own Google Business Profile, call tracking, and analytics (we provide onboarding guidance).
  • Keeping your contact and billing details current.
  • Submitting content updates by email.

6. Limited Warranty & Disclaimers

As-is service:

  • Your website is provided “as-is” without warranty of any kind.
  • We build and maintain lead-capture machinery. We do not promise a specific number of leads, calls, traffic, rankings, or revenue.
  • SEO is optimized on our side; search ranking depends on many factors outside our control.

We are not responsible for:

  • Business decisions you make based on site analytics.
  • Traffic quality, conversion rates, or lead quality.
  • Accuracy or legality of content you provide.
  • Third-party services (Google Business, call tracking, payment processors, registrars).
  • Uptime beyond the 99.5% monthly target.

Limitation of liability:

  • For Managed Growth, our total liability is capped at the fees you paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.
  • For Ownership, our total liability is capped at the $497 fee paid.
  • We are not liable for lost revenue, lost business, lost data, or indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages.

7. Revisions & Content Changes

During initial build:

  • Up to 2 rounds of revisions before launch to get the site to the agreed specification.

After launch (Managed Growth):

  • Unlimited small content edits are included (see Section 2 for scope), submitted by email.
  • Requests outside that scope are either added as platform-wide configurable features or declined; they are not billed as per-customer work.

Ownership plan:

  • Revisions are limited to the 2 pre-launch rounds. After export and handoff there are no further revisions.

8. Data & Privacy

Information we collect:

  • Business name, address, phone, email, and existing website details
  • Services offered, service areas, hours
  • Logo and brand colors
  • Photos, testimonials, and reviews you provide
  • Site usage metadata (hosting logs, analytics)

How we use it:

  • To build, host, and maintain your website
  • To provide support and send billing and platform notices
  • To improve our service using aggregated, anonymized data only
  • We never sell your data.

Storage & security:

  • Data is stored on Railway cloud infrastructure.
  • All site traffic uses HTTPS (SSL).
  • Backups are encrypted and retained 30 days.
  • Access is restricted to BuildFlow staff.
  • We follow GDPR and CCPA principles. A Data Processing Agreement is available on request.

Breach notification:

  • If your data is breached, we will notify you within 48 hours with details of what was accessed and our remediation steps.

Full detail is in our Privacy Policy.

9. Intellectual Property

Your content:

  • You retain all rights to content you provide.
  • You grant us a license to use that content solely to build, host, and maintain your website (and, under Ownership, to produce your export).

BuildFlow’s platform:

  • The multi-tenant application, templates, design system, and code remain BuildFlow’s property.
  • Under Managed Growth you receive a license to have your site served from the platform for your business only — not the code itself.
  • Under Ownership you receive the exported static output (HTML, CSS, images, content) for your business only. You may not resell or redistribute the template or design system, or reuse it for other businesses.

10. Third-Party Services

We rely on:

  • Hosting: Railway
  • DNS/CDN: Cloudflare
  • Email: Gmail / transactional email for form submissions and notices
  • Payments: Stripe
  • Analytics: Google Analytics (optional; you control tracking)
  • Call tracking: CallRail, Invoca, or similar (optional; you integrate and pay for it)

You are responsible for:

  • Accepting the relevant third-party terms.
  • Paying for any optional third-party services you choose to add.
  • Managing your own Google Business Profile and analytics.

11. Payment Terms Summary

  • Managed Growth: $99/mo or $990/yr, billed in advance via Stripe, auto-renewing until cancelled. Optional $199 setup fee, waived for early customers. No refund or proration for a period already started.
  • Ownership: $497 one-time via Stripe, authorized before work begins, non-refundable once the export and handoff are delivered.
  • If a post-launch technical fault on our infrastructure prevents a Managed Growth site from loading, we fix it at no charge.

12. Support & Contact

Support channels:

  • Email: support@buildflow.com
  • Response time: 24–48 hours

Issues we handle (Managed Growth):

  • Technical problems (site not loading, SSL errors, form delivery failures)
  • Hosting and performance issues
  • Domain/DNS routing problems
  • Questions about your service and included content edits

Issues we don’t handle:

  • Google Business Profile optimization (we provide guides; you manage the profile)
  • SEO/ranking work beyond our standard optimization
  • Content strategy or copywriting beyond your kickoff inputs
  • Third-party tool integration you choose to add

Under the Ownership plan, support is limited to the one-month transition window.

13. Limitation on Legal Liability

You assume all business risk:

  • Your website is used at your own risk.
  • We provide and operate the technical machinery; you are responsible for content, legality, and business outcomes.
  • We do not guarantee leads, calls, traffic, conversions, or revenue.

Liability cap:

  • Managed Growth: limited to fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
  • Ownership: limited to the $497 fee paid.
  • No liability for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages, or for lost revenue, business, or data.

14. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

  • These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Arizona.
  • Disputes will first be addressed by email within 30 days.
  • If unresolved, either party may pursue mediation or small claims court.
  • For disputes over $5,000, both parties agree to binding arbitration.

15. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. If changes are material, we will email you at least 30 days in advance. Continued use of the service after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.
